Terms.Name: Anti-citizen
Terms.Description: A status bestowed to a citizen who is deemed a threat

Terms.Name: Biotic
Terms.Description: Living organisms, distinct from synthetic or mechanical entities (i.e., antlions, vortiguants, etc.)

Terms.Name: Exogen
Terms.Description: External forces, typically referring to any hostile entities outside of Combine's control

Terms.Name: Malcompliant
Terms.Description: An individual who is disobedient or engages in defiance

Terms.Name: Malignant
Terms.Description: Used to describe a criminally active or a malicious force / threat

Terms.Name: Necrotic
Terms.Description: Reanimated organisms, commonly referred to as zombies

Terms.Name: Non-citizen
Terms.Description: A status bestowed to an individual stripped of their citizenship

Terms.Name: Person of interest
Terms.Description: A person being monitored, sought or questioned in connection with a criminal investigation or security operation, especially as a potential suspect

Terms.Name: Virome
Terms.Description: A pack, group or community of aliens
